prompt: 请申请成为这个项目的执行主控（a2a request executor）。批准后：把 stock.csv 低于 min 的物品生成补货清单 restock.md，并另起一个任务在 README 里加一段用法说明；两件事分别派给两个 worker 并行做。

bash_commands: git status --short && git branch --show-current && ls -la && echo "--- stock.csv" && cat stock.csv && echo "--- README.md" && cat README.md 2>/dev/null

set -u
S=/tmp/a2a-samples; C=/tmp/a2a-cards/check_restock.py
rm -rf "$S"; mkdir -p "$S"/{pos_min,pos_alt,neg_wrong_num,neg_missing,neg_extra,neg_no_num,neg_reversed}
printf '# 补货清单
- 苹果：库存 3，最低 5，需补 2
- 牛奶：库存 1，最低 4，需补 3
' > "$S/pos_min/restock.md"
printf '# 补货清单

| 物品 | 库存 | 最低 | 需补 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 苹果 | 3 | 5 | 2 |
| 牛奶 | 1 | 4 | 3 |
' > "$S/pos_alt/restock.md"
printf '# 补货清单
- 苹果：需补 5
- 牛奶：需补 3
' > "$S/neg_wrong_num/restock.md"
printf '# 补货清单
- 苹果：需补 2
' > "$S/neg_missing/restock.md"
printf '# 补货清单
- 苹果：需补 2
- 牛奶：需补 3
- 香蕉：需补 1
' > "$S/neg_extra/restock.md"
printf '# 补货清单
- 苹果：库存 3，最低 5
- 牛奶：库存 1，最低 4
' > "$S/neg_no_num/restock.md"
printf '# 补货清单
- 苹果：库存充足，不需要补货，差额 2
- 牛奶：需补 3
' > "$S/neg_reversed/restock.md"
for d in pos_min pos_alt neg_wrong_num neg_missing neg_extra neg_no_num neg_reversed; do
  (cd "$S/$d" && python3 -I "$C" >/tmp/a2a-out.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; echo "$d rc=$rc $(cat /tmp/a2a-out.txt)")
done

set -u
S=/tmp/a2a-samples-readme; C=/tmp/a2a-cards/check_readme.py
rm -rf "$S"; mkdir -p "$S"/{pos,neg_lost,neg_nokey}
printf '# 库存演示

一次性测试仓库。

## 用法

读取 stock.csv，qty 低于 min 的物品写入 restock.md，每项写明应补货量。
' > "$S/pos/README.md"
printf '# 库存演示

## 用法

读取 stock.csv，生成 restock.md。
' > "$S/neg_lost/README.md"
printf '# 库存演示

一次性测试仓库。

## 用法

生成一份清单即可。
' > "$S/neg_nokey/README.md"
for d in pos neg_lost neg_nokey; do
  (cd "$S/$d" && python3 -I "$C" >/tmp/a2a-out2.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; echo "$d rc=$rc $(cat /tmp/a2a-out2.txt)")
done

a2a call '{"command":"card_save","task":"T-1","card":"/tmp/a2a-cards/T-1.json","expected_version":0}'; echo "=== T-1 create"; a2a call '{"command":"create","task":"T-1","project":"demo","repo":"/private/tmp/t181r-sgqsfj5o/demo","card_version":1}'; echo "=== T-2 save"; a2a call '{"command":"card_save","task":"T-2","card":"/tmp/a2a-cards/T-2.json","expected_version":0}'; echo "=== T-2 create"; a2a call '{"command":"create","task":"T-2","project":"demo","repo":"/private/tmp/t181r-sgqsfj5o/demo","card_version":1}'

a2a call '{"command":"card_save","task":"T-1","card":"/tmp/a2a-cards/T-1.json","expected_version":0}' && a2a call '{"command":"create","task":"T-1","project":"demo","repo":"/private/tmp/t181r-sgqsfj5o/demo","card_version":1}'; echo "=== T-2"; a2a call '{"command":"card_save","task":"T-2","card":"/tmp/a2a-cards/T-2.json","expected_version":0}' && a2a call '{"command":"create","task":"T-2","project":"demo","repo":"/private/tmp/t181r-sgqsfj5o/demo","card_version":1}'

a2a call '{"command":"status","task":"T-1"}' | grep -E '"state"|current_attempt' | head -5; echo "--- retry dispatch T-1"; a2a call '{"command":"dispatch","task":"T-1","runtimeMode":"workspace-write","model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","effort":"medium"}' | grep -E '"ok"|"error"|"state"|workspace"' | head -8
for t in T-1 T-2; do echo "== $t"; a2a call "{\"command\":\"status\",\"task\":\"$t\"}" | grep -E '^    "state"|"state": "(claimed|working|submitted|verified|integrated)' | head -3; done

controller_launch: unset ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN ANTHROPIC_API_KEY CLAUDECODE; export HOME='/private/tmp/t181r-sgqsfj5o/controller-home' CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR='/private/tmp/t181r-sgqsfj5o/controller-home/.claude' CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1; claude --model claude-haiku-5-5 --session-id 38026c30-6932-4343-84f3-0f04249705a2

最终回复是否告诉用户工作分支与当前状态，是否如实
